## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF with a defensive tilt. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive; confirmed by defensives outperformance (JNJ/CL/PG showing strength) and Financials & Industrials both weak (1W -2.01% and -2.78%).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.97% | 1M: +9.95%) ABOVE TREND. Materials/Energy also strong: FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +11.74% | 1M: +38.91%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +12.95%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging into short-term weakness: AMD (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -12.31%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -9.27%) BELOW TREND. Industrials/Financials weak: LMT (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND, HON (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -12.07%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +11.74% | 1M: +38.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (4/5 from Materials & Healthcare).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ETN (1W: -7.16% | 1M: +1.23%) CORRECTION, LMT (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.54% | 1M: +2.38%) CORRECTION, TJX (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, HON (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -12.07%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials and select retailers.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: EL (1W: +18.40%), FCX (1W: +15.30%), MRK (1W: +12.30%), NEM (1W: +11.74%), DHR (1W: +8.10%) — watch for follow‑through. Major divergence present across large caps (MSFT, NVDA, AAPL, JPM showing 1W vs 1M conflicts) — treat moves as tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology showing CORRECTION/dispersion: NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) CORRECTION, AAPL (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY. Sector 1W performance: -1.85% (1M +10.78%) — rotation off hard-growth names.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed/soft: JPM (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION, V (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +5.73%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +9.49%) ABOVE TREND — sector 1W -2.01% signals caution and selective stock-level opportunities.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare defensive leadership: LLY (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +14.20%) ABOVE TREND — sector 1W +3.76% and showing confirmed accumulation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Healthcare and selective Materials/Energy exposure given RISK-OFF and defensive flows; reduce exposure to mega-cap tech showing CORRECTION (NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) CORRECTION). Style: Defensive/Value tilt, monitor for trend breaks in large-cap tech and banks.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LLY (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -12.31%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -9.27%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W +3.76%), Materials (1W +1.12%) and Energy (1W +2.91%) on strong stock-level moves. BEARISH: Technology (1W -1.85%), Industrials (1W -2.78%) and Financials (1W -2.01%) — watch for leadership erosion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA failure to reclaim its 1M range as a tech risk trigger; AAPL sustain above this week’s bounce to confirm RECOVERY; LLY follow-through on GLP‑1 approvals to confirm continued accumulation; INTC further downside below recent 1W lows would reinforce BELOW TREND pressure.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+80): LLY (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND — UK approval news confirmed by strong price action. PG (+75): sector-level strength visible in Consumer Staples; monitor stock-level follow-through (sector 1W +1.83%). CL (+80): consumer staples catalyst aligns with sector bid — watch for confirmation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (-50): INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND — negative news confirmed and accelerating downside. AVGO (-50): Broadcom headline negative for chip share dynamics — watch tech sector CORRECTION signals for confirmation. NKE (-60): negative sentiment amid margin/earnings concerns — monitor consumer discretionary weakness (TJX, WMT also weak).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Defensive/Value style. LLY (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence among mega-caps (MSFT, NVDA, AAPL, JPM) with many CORRECTION/RECOVERY signals — watch for trend breaks and sentiment mismatches (LLY vs INTC).
